gate: Gate-D step 7 diagnostic; no accepted simulation output produced
purpose: decide cheaply whether the count-constrained candidate demand simulates as a healthy signalised network or gridlocks, before committing to a full-window run that would cost hours and tens of gigabytes of one-second FCD

method.fcd_omitted_because: FCD is what costs the disk; the summary answers the question for a few megabytes
method.network: Manchester local-authority study subnetwork, 285,794 real edges
method.demand: count-constrained candidate demand, 748,589 vehicles across 212,666 flows

verdict.teleports_growth: 113 to 21,669 over a sixfold increase in elapsed time, a 192-fold rise
verdict.reasoning: A signalised urban network legitimately shows a high halting share, because a vehicle waiting at a red light is halting. Teleports do not have that excuse: SUMO teleports a vehicle only after it has been blocked beyond the 300 second threshold. Teleports rose superlinearly and reached 35.7% of all inserted vehicles, insertion rate more than halved as the network filled, and the queue of vehicles unable to enter grew twentyfold. The network is not absorbing the demand.

consequence_for_the_planned_run.full_window_run: would produce tens of gigabytes of one-second FCD describing a mostly stationary network with over a third of vehicles teleporting, which is unusable for the VEC chain and for any observed-versus-simulated comparison
consequence_for_the_planned_run.one_peak_hour_run: this diagnostic was one hour and it gridlocked, so a bounded window does not avoid the problem
consequence_for_the_planned_run.decision: no full-window or peak-hour FCD run was performed

hypotheses_not_investigated: the route pool was generated with a fringe factor of 5 and a 300 m minimum distance, which biases it towards long cross-network trips. A vehicle on a long route occupies the network for a long time and satisfies several counting locations at once, so matching the counts needs fewer vehicles but loads the network far more than the per-edge counts alone imply.
real urban traffic contains many short local trips that this pool does not represent
routeSampler was run with -f number and no departure-time shaping within each hourly interval, so departures may cluster
traffic signals in the network are netconvert defaults and have not been calibrated
hypothesis_status: none of the above has been tested. They are recorded so the next step starts from candidates rather than from scratch, and no adjustment has been made to the demand.
why_nothing_was_tuned: adjusting the demand until it simulated smoothly would hide the finding this diagnostic exists to produce, and no such adjustment is authorised
cost_avoided: the full-window run projected to at least 37 GB of FCD and several hours of compute. The diagnostic cost about ten minutes and one megabyte of summary output.
explicit_non_claims: no accepted simulation output was produced
this is a diagnostic, not a result, and not a calibration or comparison
the demand has not been altered, tuned, or rejected
MAN-09 remains planned; Gate D and Gate E remain foundation_only
